journey.name: Starter: receive NIGHT
journey.description:
The wallet must show NIGHT that somebody else sent it, and it must hand out the address they sent it to. Those are the two halves of receiving, and nothing else in the suite covers either: every other journey either stops before the wallet opens or watches money the app itself moved.
The funding is real and external — `mn airdrop` mints from the localnet genesis wallet while the app is not running, so the balance on screen is money the app discovered rather than money it was told about. `scripts/money-journeys.sh prepare` does that and prints the address it funded; the journey asserts the receive screen names an address of the same family and that the balance cleared the floor the script guarantees.
Localnet, not a public testnet, because `mn` is only a complete counterparty there: airdrop mints from genesis in one command, while a testnet has no faucet and a wallet funded to send cannot register for dust until its coin has aged an hour.
NOT covered here: NIGHT arriving while the app is in the foreground, and the background-receive notification. Both need a second party sending on a timer the journey cannot drive.
Preconditions this journey does NOT set up, and fails honestly without: - a debuggable build whose local.properties sets kuira.dev.seed, so there is a wallet without a passkey ceremony; - a ledger-8 localnet answering on the pinned endpoints (`mn localnet up`); - `scripts/money-journeys.sh prepare`, which funds that wallet and prints its address; - the app set to the localnet network.
Verified end to end on localnet 2026-10-24: with the app force-stopped, `mn airdrop 500` took the wallet from 9,999 to 10,499 NIGHT on chain. The app was then launched cold, opened its wallet from the declared dev seed with no sigil ceremony and no cloud-backup prompt, and read 10,499 — money it had never been told about. The receive screen named the same address the airdrop went to, and offered the `mn airdrop` line to fund it again.

actions.action: If a notification permission prompt is shown, decline it
If a "Keep your wallet synced" backup offer is shown, choose "Not now"
Verify the screen does NOT show "A previous wallet backup was found in your cloud"
Verify the wallet shows a NIGHT balance of at least 100
Verify the screen shows a "Receive" control
Verify the screen shows "Receive NIGHT on Undeployed"
Verify the screen shows an address beginning "mn_addr_undeployed"
Verify the screen shows "tap address to copy"
Verify the screen shows "fund via cli"
Verify the screen shows a command beginning "mn airdrop"
Tap the address shown under the QR code
Verify the screen still shows "Receive NIGHT on Undeployed"
